title: Checkout.com - Steep learning curve for advanced features and limited mobile tooling
clean_text: Reviewers describe a learning curve for Checkout.com's more advanced features, alongside occasional bugs and a desire for more customization options. Mobile app capabilities are described as limited compared to the web dashboard. Feedback is notably split by platform: G2 gives Checkout.com strong marks for ease of use and customer support (4.6/5 across 70 reviews), while Trustpilot reviewers rate it far lower (2.2/5 across 81 reviews), with reported shortcomings in customer service and suitability for very small businesses (consistent with its enterprise-only focus).
